title: Brauer Group Core
abstract: Formalizes central simple algebra infrastructure, Wedderburn-Artin structure theorems, and finite-field triviality for Brauer groups.

informal.BrauerGroup.BruaerGroup: Constructs the Brauer group of a field from Brauer equivalence classes of central simple algebras.
informal.BrauerGroupHom.Br: Constructs the Brauer group functor from fields to commutative groups via scalar extension.
informal.WedderburnArtin: Proves a Wedderburn-Artin decomposition for simple Artinian rings as matrix algebras over division rings.
informal.trivialBrauer: Proves that every element of the Brauer group of a finite field is trivial.
informal.WedderburnArtin_algebra_version: Gives an algebra equivalence form of Wedderburn-Artin for finite-dimensional central simple algebras.
informal.IsCentralSimple.TensorProduct.simple: Proves simplicity of tensor products of central simple algebras over a field.
informal.IsCentralSimple.TensorProduct.isCentral: Proves centrality of tensor products of central algebras over a field.
informal.CSA_implies_CSA: Shows that the division algebra factor in a matrix presentation of a central simple algebra is central over the base field.
